_comment: Detection lists for advisor checks. verified=false entries are best-known names; an absent name produces 'not found' wording, never a hard problem.

amdChipset._comment: amdgpio2, amdi2c and AmdPPM are inbox Windows drivers present on every PC, so they are not listed. No AMD page names these service keys; not used by any check (AmdChipsetCheck reads the installed programs).

apoCpus._comment: Intel Application Optimization: verified processors from Intel article 000095419 (desktop: 14th gen i5/i7/i9 K and KF, i9 14900KS, Core Ultra 200S K/KF and K Plus; mobile: i7/i9 14th gen HX, Core Ultra 200HX and HX Plus, Core Ultra 7 356H and Ultra 9 386H).
